newsitem.title: USA: Delta sees rise in Q3 passenger mile yield.
newsitem.headline: Delta sees rise in Q3 passenger mile yield.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc Friday said that it expects system passenger mile yield for the March 1997 quarter to improve moderately versus the March 1996 quarter, according to preliminary February revenue data.
Delta also expects to report strong year-over-year improvements in system operating revenue per available seat mile for the March quarter, its third.

The firm also noted that Delta's operating cost per available seat mile for the March 1997 quarter is expected to be essentially flat versus the March 1996 quarter -- excluding fuel expense, restructuring and other non-recurring charges.
